description:
Listen to Gillian Welch and David Rawlings talk about their mentor, Guy Clark
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Sunday, May 17, 2026, marks the 10th anniversary of the passing of the Texas-born, Nashville-based singer-songwriter Guy Clark. When Gillian Welch and David Rawlings visited The Current for a session on Radio Heartland back in September 2024, they spoke warmly of Guy Clark’s influence and mentorship. Watch their interview with Radio Heartland host/producer Mike Pengra, above.

The Current’s Bill DeVille will pay tribute to the late Guy Clark on the May 17 episode of United States of Americana.
